text.description_html:
Don-Jo Stainless Steel 4 x 9 Push Plate

Common size 4" x 16" commercial door push plate . Primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories and stores. Made in the USA from .050" thick solid stainless steel with a satin finish. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of the Don-Jo 91 Stainless Steel Push Plate:

  • Plate Height: 9"
  • Plate Width: 4"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

*Sold Individually.
